# Frontend Architecture

- Keep components focused and composable.
- Separate presentation, state, data access, and business rules where useful.
- Prefer local state until shared/global state is justified.
- Avoid deeply coupled components and prop drilling across many layers.
- Define stable API contracts and loading/error/empty states.
- Design reusable components around behavior, not speculative abstraction.
- Preserve accessibility, responsiveness, and performance during refactors.
